reviews.x: I purchased this set as a gift for my husband. He uses them to paint miniature dwarves, wizards, etc. The handles are big enough for him to hold in is hand, which is great since I was worried the entire brush would be like holding a pin. He's told me the angled brush is the most useful of the set.

reviews.t: Angled 10/0 Brush Perfect for Gel Eyeliner Application
reviews.x: I realize this is not what these brushes are intended for; however, the two 10/0 brushes are AMAZING gel eyeliner brushes.  I absolutely love the La Corneille Golden Taklon Tight Spot Detailer Brush 7670 for applying my MAC gel eyeliner (the angled brush in the picture).  The angle allows me to work behind my lashes (they don't get in the way) and the thin, precise tip gives me a perfect eyeliner line!  The bristles are taklon like many of my makeup brushes, so they're firm enough to work with t

I bought these brushes to paint small 28mm figures with achrylic paints. So far I have found them to be great. The smallest brush is perfect for intricate detail. At such a low price I would recommend picking up a set or 2 if you are afraid you might ruin one of the brush by over using it.

These are really cool! and they help me get the detail I want. But honestly, they don't feel as High Quality as Citadel Brushes! These brushes frayed rather quickly and the smallest one actually lost some hair! I am very carefully and protect them!

reviews.t: A must for what I do
reviews.x: I have only used one of the brushes, so far. Compared to what I have used, this is far superior.  I would like to have seen, (from the manufacturer),   a suggestion as to what to use to clean, and how   to store and care for these brushes. I've looked as several ads of these brushes and found   no suggestions. I see only ads for a small amount, (and expensive),   cleaner. That I've read some reviews of.  I  greatly enjoy using the one I have used.

reviews.t: Great set of brushes for the price
reviews.x: I like the large round handles and the brush sizes are just right for the small plastic models I put together.  Angled brush is great for those hard to reach places.  My only complaint is that the bristles could be stiffer for better paint detailing.  Overall good purchase though.

I do a lot of wee little painting on fairy houses I build. This was a gift to myself...and I love me for it. Though they were not terribly expensive they have quickly become my favorite brushes. I plan to purchase a second set for myself and a set for my niece.
has everything i need for a very detailed picture. i love how sharp i can be with this set and every brush has its own job. love it.

reviews.t: Good brushes, but could use better glue
reviews.x: The brushes are good, but the silver part that has the brush part in it, does come unglued from the wood handle quite easily
good set, i like the large rounded handles, tips hold up pretty well after using it for a few months.

reviews.t: These were indispensable for the fine lines I was painting in my icon
reviews.x: These were indispensable for the fine lines I was painting in my icon. I had tried several other fine brushes, but the hair on the brushes tended to fuzz out, and I would not get a clean line, or the paint would start to clump. The variety of styles and brush designs helped me keep a fine straight line when I needed one, helped add fine detail in the facial features, and cleaned up beautifully and stayed clean and straight. It annoys me to have brush protectors that will not go back on once they

For me, there fine. Although, when I got them the caps were not on the brushes (they were laying in the bottom of the bag) which caused them to fray. I have a solution that I dip my brushes in so they hold there place so it was fine for me but not sure about other people.

reviews.t: higher price but higher quality. packaging could be better.
reviews.x: Very good quality and the weight of them is very nice and allows for much greater control than cheaper brushes. they only came in a small plastic bag however and I had to straighten some of the bristles because of inadequate protection.

Brushes are pretty good and are great for super tiny details. Brush tips are nice and stiff too. The packaging they came in sucked though and several of the tips bent or were frayed. One of them is kinda useless now
I use these to paint Dungeons and Dragons miniatures. They work PeRFECTLY!  Even on a halfling. The handles are wonderful and the bristles are a great quality.  You could use these for many things.
The brushes are fine but do not leave the handles in the thinner for too long. After 1 hour the tip was dissolved and the brush detached from the handle.
Ordered this for my son for a project he's planning to do and I wish I had ordered myself one.  I paint ceramics and this is a really nice set.
The quality is not what I expected. They were not packaged effectively. The bristles were not straight.

reviews.t: Nice teeny tiny brushes for detailing miniatures.
reviews.x: Just an FYI, these arrived lose in a bag, inside a very sturdy small cardboard package. All had the bristle covers, except one. The one without the cover, luckily, was not frayed. These brushes are tiny and perfect for detailing miniatures. I find it hard to find brushes this small and was pleasantly surprised when they arrived.  I go through quite alot of brushes, so I wanted to try some less expensive ones. The handle is shorter than an average paint brush, which I prefer. Also, the thicker ha

reviews.t: Very good brushes for detail work.
reviews.x: These brushes are very good. Hold the paint well and the shape of the handles make them easy to grip and do fine work. I often have problems with brushes that have very thin handles moving in ways that I do not want them to. I use them for modeling and the one with the bent end is very hand when using a magnifying glass as it fit in the space between  the lens and the part easily. Will update when I see how they hold up during usage.

reviews.t: Good as a first set of quality brushes.
reviews.x: These seem to be high quality. I have used them a handful of times now and found them to generally hold their shape well, though there have been a few stray strands that have made me nervous. I don't have enough experience with painting minis to really feel confident giving them a 5, but they are definitely what I was looking for for fine details and the ability to reach into crevices.

I use these brushes for doing detail work on my gundam models. There's a nice variety of brush types in this pack and they are comfortable and very high quality. I would recommend these for anyone who likes to paint models or figurines. They're also good for any other fine art application where you need to create tiny details

These brushes are like I've never seen before!!! They are just perfect and really works well for detailing. The tips are so fine and the fineness does not wear out. It's a bit pricey but it's worth every penny especially if you are a professional artist or a real, hardcore hobbyist.

I ordered these for my boyfriend as a gift.  He has just gotten into painting miniature figures of War Hammer 40k solders.  They work very well for the tiny little details on the figures.  I would recommend these brushes for anyone wanting to do detail work on anything small.

I have owned 2 of these brushes before and used them until they died (gasp! choke! wheeze!) I didn't even realized that they came as a set until I saw this on Amazon. You better believe I bought it!!!! I kissed the package when it arrived. Now I have all of them!!!!!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these brushes for fine detail work, such as painting miniatures, figures, and other small projects.
Many customers consider the set a great value for the price and quality.
Several reviewers like the large, rounded handles for comfortable control.
A recurring complaint is that bristles frayed or bent, sometimes due to poor packaging.
Some reviewers report durability issues, including bristle loss and the metal ferrule coming unglued from the handle.
